recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中可見異型巨核細胞成群聚集、細胞核深染不規則，伴隨擴張充血的竇狀血管與出血，右側骨小樑增厚，是骨髓纖維化合併骨硬化的中倍影像。
features: Clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic, irregular, cloud-like nuclei
Dilated, congested sinusoids with extravasated red cells
Fibrotic, loosely arranged stroma between cellular areas
Thickened bony trabecula at the right edge
describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic, irregularly lobated, cloud-like nuclei set in a loose fibrotic stroma. Sinusoids are dilated and congested, with extravasated red cells and intrasinusoidal hematopoietic cells, and an adjacent bony trabecula appears thickened. Normal granulocytic and erythroid precursors are reduced. Findings are consistent with a fibrotic-stage myeloproliferative neoplasm with osteosclerosis, most suggestive of primary myelofibrosis.

ddx.vs: ET megakaryocytes are giant with hyperlobulated staghorn nuclei, loosely scattered, without significant fibrosis or sinusoidal dilation.
MDS-F features small hypolobated megakaryocytes and multilineage dysplasia rather than bulbous hyperchromatic megakaryocyte clusters.
APMF has increased CD34-positive blasts (≥20%) with small dysplastic megakaryocytes and an acute clinical course.
